segments.contextAfter: In combination, these constraints result in the following typical stack view behavior: In a stack view whose [`hasEqualSpacing`](nsstackview/hasequalspacing.md) property is set to [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) (the default) and whose hugging priority is left at [`defaultLow`](nslayoutconstraint/priority-swift.struct/defaultlow.md) (the default), views within a gravity area remain a fixed distance from each other (equal to the value of the [`spacing`](nsstackview/spacing.md) property), and the distance between gravity areas grows and shrinks as the stack view grows and shrinks along its layout direction axis.

If you set the [`hasEqualSpacing`](nsstackview/hasequalspacing.md) property to [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) and use the default hugging priority, then the distance between all adjacent views, including adjacent views in neighboring gravity areas, grows and shrinks as the stack view grows and shrinks.
